_comment: Descriptive JSON-shape schema for data/classes/<id>.json (per-Class definition: base stats, per-level scaling, primary attack, RMB Class ability, appearance, networking). This is a human-readable shape guide for validators/tooling, NOT a strict JSON-Schema document. The Rust omega-server constants are the numeric authority for every value a class file holds (the class file is a client mirror; the server wins on disagreement) — 'the client requests, the server decides.' Governing GDD docs: docs/gdd/classes/index.md (enum order, base stats + per-level scaling table), docs/gdd/classes/<id>.md, docs/systems/abilities.md, docs/systems/PROGRESSION.md. TODO: promote to a formal JSON-Schema (draft 2020-12) if the validators/ pipeline requires it; current entry is descriptive only.

fields.id: string — stable class id, matches filename (e.g. 'warrior')

stats.mana_max: int (100 for all classes — gameplay pool)

ability.name: string
ability._note: remaining keys are ability-shape-specific (e.g. blast_radius, charge_speed, radius, dps)

invariants: class enum/byte order: 0 Zealot,1 VoidHunter,2 Engineer,3 PlagueSeer,4 Warrior,5 Rogue,6 Mage
only Warrior/Rogue/Mage active in pre-alpha (others deferred)
